# MlHub API

> REST API for ML Terminal Snippets — skill repositories, project templates, terminal snippets, SSH presets, crash tracking, and activity task management. Vapor 4 + PostgreSQL.

## Machine-readable

- OpenAPI 3: GET /openapi.yaml (repo copy: docs/openapi.yaml)
- This file: GET /llms.txt

## Base URLs

- Development: http://localhost:8080
- Docker (default): http://localhost:4141

## Authentication

None in v1. API is intended for trusted local network use.

## Resources

- GET/POST /api/repositories — skill git repositories; slug must be unique (409 on duplicate)
- GET/POST /api/skills — Cursor Agent Skills; requires valid repositoryId (400); repositorySlug/gitURL read-only in responses
- GET/POST /api/mcp-servers — Cursor MCP server presets; requires valid repositoryId (400); repositorySlug/gitURL read-only in responses
- GET/POST /api/projects — project templates; includes selectedSkillSlugs array; DELETE blocked if crash reports, activity logs, or activity tasks exist → 409
- GET/POST /api/crash-reports — app crash reports linked to projects; projectName read-only; filter ?projectId=
- POST /api/crash-reports/import — Crashlytics upsert by externalId
- GET /api/crash-reports/{id}/detail — aggregated report + diagnoses + fix strategy + postmortem
- GET/POST /api/crash-diagnoses — diagnosis notes; crashReportId required; optional ?crashReportId=
- GET/POST /api/crash-fix-strategies — one per crash report → 409 on duplicate
- GET/POST /api/crash-postmortems — one per crash report; publishedAt sets status postmortem_published
- GET/POST /api/activity-logs — daily activity logs linked to projects; projectName read-only; filter ?projectId= ?logDate=
- GET /api/activity-logs/{id}/detail — aggregated log + tasks
- GET/POST /api/activity-tasks — tasks within a log; requires projectId + activityLogId; filter ?projectId= ?activityLogId= ?status= ?category=
- GET/POST /api/snippet-categories — groups for terminal snippets
- GET/POST /api/terminal-snippets — command snippets; requires valid categoryId
- GET/POST /api/ssh-connections — SSH presets (display paths only, no secret keys)
- GET /health — liveness; GET /health?db=1 — includes PostgreSQL ping

All resources support GET/PUT/DELETE /api/{resource}/{id} with UUID path parameter.

## JSON conventions

- Property names: camelCase (not snake_case)
- Dates: ISO8601 strings
- IDs: UUID strings
- Successful DELETE: HTTP 204 No Content
- Errors: JSON { "reason": "...", "error": true }

## Business rules

- repositories.slug is UNIQUE → 409 Conflict on create/update collision
- DELETE /api/repositories/{id} with linked skills or MCP servers → 409 Conflict
- DELETE /api/snippet-categories/{id} with child snippets → 409 Conflict
- DELETE /api/projects/{id} with crash reports, activity logs, or activity tasks → 409 Conflict
- POST /api/activity-tasks duplicate externalId for same projectId → 409 Conflict
- POST /api/activity-tasks with activityLogId from another project → 400 Bad Request
- POST /api/crash-fix-strategies duplicate for same crashReportId → 409 Conflict
- POST /api/crash-postmortems duplicate for same crashReportId → 409 Conflict
- POST /api/crash-reports/import upserts by (source=crashlytics, externalId)
- POST /api/skills with unknown repositoryId → 400 Bad Request
- POST /api/mcp-servers with unknown repositoryId → 400 Bad Request
- POST /api/terminal-snippets with unknown categoryId → 400 Bad Request
- Invalid UUID in path → 400 Bad Request
- Missing resource → 404 Not Found

## Typical agent workflow

1. GET /health?db=1 — confirm API and database
2. GET /openapi.yaml — load full schemas and operationIds
3. GET /api/{resource} — list before create to avoid duplicates
4. Use request body schemas from OpenAPI components (Create* schemas)
